name: openmc

tool_versions.accepted: exactly 0.15.3 for transport; 0.16 or later for the separate weight-window generator

inputs.name: transport request
inputs.unit: SI as stated per field in the request

inputs.name: physics case
inputs.unit: g/cm3 and atom fractions for materials; cm for geometry

outputs.name: raw tallies, statepoint and exact loss-count artifact
outputs.unit: per source neutron, as the artifact states per tally
outputs.label: calculated

outputs.name: group spectra
outputs.unit: per source neutron per energy group
outputs.label: calculated

units: The worker returns raw OpenMC tallies per source neutron (RAW_PER_SOURCE_NEUTRON). The absolute source normalisation is applied once, in the Rust normaliser, never in the Python worker; geometry is in cm and densities in g/cm3 as OpenMC defines them.
execution_mode: The selected OpenMC executable and its exact verified linked C library are recorded separately. The physics run calls openmc_run through that C API library so FARIS can read n_lost_particles; it does not silently substitute the Python package's shared-library copy.
cancellation: The job runner owns a process group and ends it, including the C API runner child. The run is then Cancelled and nothing is stored as a result.

failures.reported_as: worker error naming the expected and found version; no run starts

failures.mode: selected executable's linked OpenMC library cannot be resolved exactly
failures.reported_as: worker error; no alternative Python package library is substituted
failures.next_step: use the selected OpenMC executable with a verified $ORIGIN/../lib/libopenmc.so in the same Python environment

failures.mode: lost-particle count absent or above the strict 1e-6-per-history limit
failures.reported_as: count is NOT_EVALUATED or exceeds the limit; normalized transport result stays unavailable
failures.next_step: repair geometry or use an OpenMC build/runtime whose exact C API count is available

failures.mode: wall time, memory, output or file limit passed
failures.reported_as: TimedOut, MemoryLimit, OutputLimit, ArtifactLimit or FileSizeLimit
failures.next_step: raise the limit knowingly or reduce the model; no result is kept

failures.mode: OpenMC exits with an error or the statepoint is missing
failures.reported_as: Failed, with the tail of the solver output
failures.next_step: read the solver output kept in the run folder

failures.mode: output fails its own checks (schema, tally identity, statepoint version)
failures.reported_as: import error in the run record; the transport result stays NOT_EVALUATED
failures.next_step: rerun the transport; the record names the file and field
